PTE request for JeyTech Order Transfer QR — French (fr_FR)

Hello Polyglots,

I am the author of JeyTech Order Transfer QR for WooCommerce, using the WordPress.org account @jeytech:

JeyTech Order Transfer QR for WooCommerce

The plugin was approved and version 1.0.0 is now published. I would like to maintain its French translations. Could the French team review the suggestions and consider granting the Project Translation Editor role for this additional project?

#fr_FR — @jeytech

All 100 active strings have French suggestions: 54 code strings and 46 Stable Readme strings. The remote exports contain no untranslated entries. The exported suggestions match the reviewed local PO files; placeholders, the {order_number} token and readme HTML have been checked. French language-pack behavior and English fallback were tested separately from the Free ZIP, which contains no translation catalogs.

The translations were prepared with automated assistance. These technical checks do not replace the French team’s language review. I will address any terminology or typography feedback before approval.

Translation projects:

Code: https://translate.wordpress.org/projects/wp-plugins/jeytech-order-transfer-qr/stable/fr/default/?filters%5Bstatus%5D=waiting&filters%5Buser_login%5D=jeytech
Readme: https://translate.wordpress.org/projects/wp-plugins/jeytech-order-transfer-qr/stable-readme/fr/default/?filters%5Bstatus%5D=waiting&filters%5Buser_login%5D=jeytech

This request covers only the newly published Order Transfer QR project; the three previous JeyTech projects were requested separately on 29 September.

Thank you for your time and guidance.

#editor-requests

Reply
Follow
Mark as done
